scope: Pending/error/recovery states for the customer chains, injected at the one seam the protection client itself depends on (linker/v1/protection prepare|verify) so the page shows its own real states. review instance, LINKER_E2E_INSTANCE=review, Turnstile dummy profile (always pass) applied for the run and restored after; consent cookies pre-seeded.
result: 4/4 passed (48.1s), Outbox queue assertion in afterAll passed

states.pending: verify held back; the add link's own p[role=status] shows the checking line; no Woo session cookie appears
states.error: verify aborted; status names 'could not be completed' and 'no request has been sent'; nothing added
states.recovery: seam passes; the same link adds for real (wp_woocommerce_session cookie, 100s bound)

states.held: submit click with aborted verification: 'no request has been sent', URL unchanged, typed email preserved
states.recovery: seam passes; same submit reaches /inquiry-received (120s bound)

states.held: same held state on form.linker-contact-form; URL unchanged
